name: brand.location_add
description: Saves a location for the brand, after its others, for every member's next post. A label the brand has already, in any case, is not added twice. Answers the brand's locations.
sql: update brandbase.brands b set locations = case when exists (select 1 from unnest(b.locations) l where lower(l) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(:label::text), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) then b.locations else array_append(b.locations, regexp_replace(btrim(:label::text), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) end where b.id = :brand returning jsonb_build_object('locations', to_jsonb(b.locations)) as result
